title: AgentExecutionResult
description: Returned by the agent runtime for one node attempt (ADR-0004 §11). ADR-0004 §9: the control plane never trusts this self-report. claimedOutput is validated against the node's declared output schema before any transition is evaluated; usage and cost are taken from the model gateway's own records rather than from the runtime's summary; tool effects are known from the tool layer's records rather than from the runtime's narrative. That is what makes this a trust boundary rather than a module boundary.

status.description: Maps onto the failure categories of ADR-0008. The runtime does not invent categories and does not decide retryability.

claimedOutput.description: Claimed, not validated. Present when status is COMPLETED.

agentLoopIterations.description: How many times the agent's internal reason-act loop ran during this one node attempt (ADR-0004 §7). Deliberately not called 'iteration': that name belongs to the graph loop round in NodeRun identity (ADR-0021 §1), and the two counters are unrelated. One node attempt has exactly one NodeRun.iteration and may have many agentLoopIterations.

stopReason.description: Why the agent loop stopped. Free text in V1: the agent runtime's internal stop conditions are not yet a closed set, unlike the graph loop's, and forcing an enum here would invite mapping unrelated causes onto the wrong constant.
